h1.text: Know every endpoint's p99 before your users do.

notes: 14 distinct font sizes. A scale of 5–7 reads as designed.
15 ornament glyphs in visible text (·11 →4). Arrows-after-links and ✳/✦ ornaments are a known tell.
7 tracked-uppercase eyebrows directly above headings. Keep only where the label carries a real category.
4 grids of 3–8 identical styled cards. Check each: would a list, table, paragraph or single image serve better?
13 gradient backgrounds. Gradients should have ≤ 2 named jobs.
5 glow-style shadows (0 0 Npx). Only things that emit light should glow.
Some paragraphs run ~159 characters per line. Keep running text at 45–90.
